answer: The delta debit happens at intake, garden totals the burned amount, and onyx anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm thus pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 22 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Honest users pay that once, farms 34 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
